title: Single Cell Isolation from Murine Kidney for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
author: Rachel Njeim
materials: Weigh and collect kidneys in ice-cold HBSS buffer.
Divide each mixture into 3 LO-bind tubes with 1 mL each and incubate on a thermomixer for 20 min at 37°C, 300xRPM. 37 °C, on a thermomixer

steps.title: Harvest Kidneys
steps.instruction: Anesthetize and perfuse the animal using HBSS buffer to harvest the kidneys.

steps.title: Isolate Glomerular and Tubular Fractions
steps.instruction: Separate the kidney tissue into glomerular and tubular fractions using sequential filtration.

substeps.instruction: Mince the kidney using a syringe plunger on a 100 mm cell strainer placed over a 50 mL Falcon tube, passing the tissue through using up to 20 mL of ice-cold HBSS.
Repeat the mincing process using a fresh 100 mm strainer and a new 50 mL Falcon tube, then wash the strainer with an additional 20 mL of ice-cold HBSS.
Pass the collected liquid through a 70 mm cell strainer placed over a clean 50 mL Falcon tube.
Collect 5 mL of the liquid (mostly tubular fraction) into a new 50 mL Falcon tube, add 5 mL of ice-cold HBSS, and set on ice.
Invert the 70 mm strainer containing the glomerular fraction over a clean 50 mL Falcon tube and rinse the contents into the tube using 10 mL of ice-cold HBSS.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the fractions to pellet the cells.

substeps.instruction: Check the suspension appearance under a microscope.
Spin down at 500xg for 5 min at 4°C using a swinging bucket rotor.

steps.title: Prepare Digestion Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 3 mL of digestion solution for each fraction (glomerular and tubular), splitting the components into two separate tubes to prevent premature enzyme action and tissue clumping.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the non-enzyme solution: 15 μl TrypLE (0.5% stock to 1X), 400 μl BSA (7.5% stock to 1%), and 746 μl HBSS (1X).

Prepare the enzyme-containing solution: 600 μl Collagenase D (10U/mL stock to 2U/mL), 1,200 μl Dispase II (5U/mL stock to 2U/mL), 30 μl DNase (1U/uL stock to 10U/mL), and 9 μl SUPERase-In RNase inhibitor (20U/uL stock to 60U/mL).

steps.title: Perform Tissue Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the tissue while maintaining cell viability.

substeps.instruction: Triturate samples by pipetting to the first stop every 5 min using a cell culture glass pipette (do not use metal needles).
Stop the digestion reaction by transferring the mixtures from 3 LO-bind tubes into 15 mL Falcon tubes.
Add 3 mL of 7.5% BSA and 2 μl DNase to each tube and mix by inverting 3 times.

steps.title: Quench and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Neutralize DNA and wash the isolated cells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2x15 mL Falcon tubes (labeled 'tubule' and 'glomeruli') containing 5 mL of 7.5% BSA and 2 μl DNase each.
Centrifuge the tubes at 500xg for 5 min at 4°C using a swinging bucket rotor.
Prepare 10 mL of ice-cold HBSS with 1% BSA (1,330 mL BSA + 8,670 mL HBSS).
Wash each pellet with 5 mL of this ice-cold HBSS and 1% BSA.

steps.title: Final Filtration and Purification
steps.instruction: Filter the cells and perform a final wash.

substeps.instruction: Pass the mixtures through BSA-pre-wetted 30 mm cell strainers into 50 mL Falcon tubes (do not touch the mesh).
Add 4 μl SUPERase-In RNase inhibitor and 4 μl DNase to the mixture.
Centrifuge the tubes at 500xg for 5 min at 4°C using a swinging bucket rotor.
Prepare 2 mL of ice-cold HBSS with 1% BSA containing SUPERase-In and DNase (266 μl 7.5% BSA, 1,732 μl 1X HBSS, 2 μl 1U/mL SUPERase-in, and 2 μl 1U/mL DNase).
Remove the supernatant and resuspend each pellet in 1 mL of ice-cold HBSS with 1% BSA.

steps.title: Cell Counting and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Assess the quantity and viability of the isolated cells.

substeps.instruction: Take 10 μl of the cell mixture, place in a hemocytometer, and capture images (10X or 20X) to count cells in both fractions.
Assess viability: Mix 5 μL of cell mixture with 5 μL of 0.4% Trypan blue stock solution, incubate for 3 min at room temperature, and capture images (10X or 20X).
To remove Trypan debris: spin down a 40 μl aliquot for 30 sec and use the top fraction only.
Verify that viability is at least 75% (up to 90%).

steps.title: Combine Fractions
steps.instruction: Combine the fractions in a BSA-coated tube to achieve a glomeruli-to-tubule ratio of 1:2.
